title: Same top class, different loss
hook: Weight all class log losses with a teacher distribution.

knows: The declared prerequisite concepts and finite arithmetic.
doesNotKnow: Teacher [1,0,0] makes soft and hard losses identical. Teacher uncertainty can transfer wrong structure; soft labels are not ground truth or guaranteed improvement. Natural logs, positive student probabilities, temperature1.

misconception: Teacher [1,0,0] makes soft and hard losses identical. Teacher uncertainty can transfer wrong structure; soft labels are not ground truth or guaranteed improvement. Natural logs, positive student probabilities, temperature1.
objective: Compute and contrast the finite distillation soft labels cases while preserving the declared boundary.

claims.text:
Your hard target tied both students at loss 0.511. Soft teacher weights instead gave A 0.950 and B 0.921, preferring B; a one-hot teacher restored the tie. Soft targets retain other-class distinctions, but teacher probabilities are not ground truth and guarantee no trained-model improvement.
